status: Exploratory reconstruction and compute feasibility; specified before production simulations
selection: Known high/low IRI range in the same 20 mM Amino assay. Different molecular sizes; not a matched perturbation or independent validation set.
molecular_state: Explicit zwitterionic free amino acids, CHARMM36 terminal templates. Original per-compound topology and simulation states unresolved.

production.integrator: LangevinMiddle, 2 fs, 1/ps friction, constrained H bonds and rigid water
production.nonbonded: PME tolerance 5e-4; 1.0 nm cutoff, LJ switch from 0.8 nm

observables: Unique water hydration counts at seven cutoffs from 0.2 to 0.5 nm
All water-oxygen to solute-atom pair histogram, 100 bins to 0.5 nm
Hydration counts divided by molecular weight, explicitly not the published volume-index model
Temperature/energy finiteness, time blocks and replicate spread
interpretation: No model fitting, no synthetic experimental labels, no ice-growth or cell-survival predictions. Short liquid-water trajectories test pipeline operation and descriptor variability; 1 ns does not establish convergence or reproduce published 20 ns simulations.

compute.local_smoke: CPU/OpenCL feasibility; 2 ps equilibration and 2 ps production are numerical checks only
compute.cloud_target: One Secure Cloud RTX 4090, or defer if unavailable; no multi-GPU or subscription
compute.shutdown: Local process watchdog plus in-Pod deadline deletion, followed by explicit result retrieval and deletion confirmation. Timers reduce overspend risk; they are not a provider-enforced account budget. Existing user resources are excluded.
compute.runtime_correction_before_production: First cloud attempt failed CUDA PTX compatibility without a trajectory and was deleted. Retried with CUDA components pinned to 12.4 and an explicit CUDA force-test success check; six-run scientific design unchanged.
